name: inspira-card-spotlight
blurb: Card with cursor-tracked radial spotlight gradient overlay.
description: A container card with a pointer-tracked radial gradient that creates a 'spotlight' effect. Gradient position follows mouse movement and resets on leave.
use_when: Premium cards, product highlights, or hero sections where subtle spotlight effects add polish and draw focus.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces or low-motion contexts where persistent spotlight tracking could be disruptive.
a11y: Card is a container for children. Spotlight is purely visual embellishment; content remains accessible.
